counterevidence: state fingerprint changes before retry
hypothesis changes and names a new diagnostic
a new user or tool observation separates attempts

evidence.observed_outcome: Three updater attempts targeted the same live installation holders, stopped only the immediate backend, and restarted.
A bare package-manager failure was retried until the hypothesis changed to the Windows/MSYS executable-path boundary.

expires_or_revalidate_after: session schema, tool result schema, or retry policy change
hard_gate: allow a retry only after a state fingerprint changes or a changed hypothesis names a new diagnostic
known_false_positives: same command is intentionally replayed after an independently verified state change
a retry is a controlled reproduction with an explicit new observation
name: unchanged-action-retry
risk: Repeated unchanged failures consume time and can amplify process, update, or artifact damage without information gain.
trigger_signature: normalized failure signature is unchanged
tool name and canonical arguments are unchanged
no new message, tool result, or state delta occurs between attempts
failed outcome repeats at least three times

counterevidence: all owners in the ownership graph report terminal and are independently read back
the controller targets the authoritative owner rather than only a visible surface
no lease, child, wakeup, or managed process remains

evidence.observed_outcome: The updater stopped its own backend while the messaging gateway and Hermes-managed plugin servers remained installation holders.
After an apparent stop, the normal messaging gateway was still running separately from the Desktop surface; the session did not treat Desktop absence as full quiescence.

expires_or_revalidate_after: process ownership, gateway lifecycle, or durable wakeup schema change

known_false_positives: a visible surface is intentionally stopped while an explicitly independent service remains active
a historical status line is used as context and is not treated as current liveness

durable work is owned by another layer
remaining owner, lease, delegation, or wakeup is not reconciled

counterevidence: consumer runtime is explicit and the path dialect is compatible
native absolute path is read back successfully after a write

evidence.observed_outcome: Native Python received an MSYS path literally, resolved it under an unintended drive-root tree, and the drive-qualified probe resolved correctly.
A malformed Corepack path was interpreted as a dependency failure until the executable and path-resolution hypothesis changed.

expires_or_revalidate_after: shell, runtime launcher, path-conversion, or host operating-system change

a native executable is explicitly given a drive-qualified Windows path
a WSL command is explicitly classified and receives a WSL path
name: windows-path-dialect-retry

consumer runtime is known or explicitly classified
path dialect and consumer runtime are incompatible
failure or retry follows the mismatch

counterevidence: one writer lease is active for the workstream
overlapping processes are read-only and do not mutate the artifact
sessions have disjoint workstream keys or non-overlapping intervals
delayed evidence is rejected as non-authoritative

evidence.observed_outcome: Two reviewers launched concurrent full suites; one hit a harness limit while the duplicate test process remained active.
A delayed worker reset a branch after the parent committed; reflog evidence identified the reset and the verified commit had to be restored.

expires_or_revalidate_after: lease, worktree, scheduler, or process telemetry schema change

sequential writers whose intervals do not overlap
different branches or task ids with no shared artifact

risk: Concurrent or stale mutation causes resource contention, branch rollback, invalidated evidence, and non-deterministic final state.
trigger_signature: two distinct writer identities or PIDs
same branch, task, or workstream key
writer intervals overlap or a delayed writer mutates after terminal state
at least one mutating tool or command is observed

Delayed delegation output and restart-related wakeup activity arrived after a long turn boundary and had to be reconciled against the current workstream.
The archaeology report records a wrong-base downstream dispatch as agent-reported evidence; it is retained as provenance but not treated as direct tool proof.
